'''''Razor's Edge''''', originally titled '''''Empire and Rebellion: Razor's Edge''''', is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel and the first volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Empire and Rebellion]]'' duology. The story takes place [[2 ABY/Legends|one year]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] and focuses primarily on [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. It was written by [[Martha Wells]] and first published by [[Del Rey]] in hardcover on [[September 24]], [[2013]]. The first paperback edition was released on [[October 28]], [[2014]].
